results.title: Spain: 69 candles lit at Toledo Cathedral for train crash victims
results.content: Spain's King Felipe VI and Queen Letizia attended a state funeral at Toledo Cathedral on Tuesday 10 November for the 69 people killed in a devastating high-speed train collision near Urda on 28 October.

results.title: Argentina: Pope Leo XIV celebrates Mass before 650,000 in Córdoba
results.content: Pope Leo XIV celebrated Mass before an estimated 650,000 people in Córdoba, Argentina. The pontiff greeted crowds from his popemobile before urging worshippers to open their hearts and embrace their faith.

results.title: Pope Leo XIV draws huge crowds in Córdoba after record Buenos Aires mass
results.content: Faithful from all over Argentina, from the farthest north of the country to Patagonia in the south and points in between, drove hours to be on hand for the service led by the Pope.

results.title: Paraguay's new president vows to recover pension funds at risk in Ueno Bank crisis
results.content: Paraguay’s new president, Pedro Alliana, promises to recover pension funds affected by the intervention in Ueno Bank. The crisis, which led to the dismissal of Santiago Peña, has left up to 7,000 people unemployed in Paraguay and other countries.

results.title: Russia’s ‘unfriendly countries’ list now targets property, child custody and debts
results.content: Moscow’s list of states it deems unfriendly was set in March 2022 for foreign economic policy, but decrees and court rulings now apply it to child custody, vehicle registration and debt repayment.

results.title: Belgium: Prince Harry and Meghan visit EU Parliament for child safety event
results.content: Prince Harry and his wife Meghan visited the European Parliament in Brussels, on Tuesday 10 November, to discuss the dangers children face online. The couple met families affected by online abuse before Harry addressed the gathering.

results.title: GCC members agree to station forces at new military command post in Kuwait
results.content: The new post in Kuwait will be part of the six Gulf countries’ joint military command, based in Riyadh, GCC announced on Tuesday.

results.title: Qatar sees 'progress' in US-Iran talks after White House meeting
results.content: A day after Prime Minister Sheikh Mohammed bin Abdulrahman Al Thani met Trump at the White House, a Qatari foreign ministry spokesman said both sides were making positive statements about a diplomatic solution but that “we cannot say how close or how far away an agreement is.”

results.title: Aerial footage reveals devastation after deadly Bulgaria highway crash
results.content: Drone footage shows the aftermath of a massive pile-up involving dozens of vehicles on a foggy highway near Yambol, Bulgaria, where 11 people were killed and dozens injured, according to state media.

results.title: Japan to supply Philippine military with coastal radar and drones
results.content: Tokyo says the new equipment will help Manila monitor shipping routes that are also important to Japan.

results.title: Trump says Iran war ‘effectively over’ as Tehran denies planned talks
results.content: Speaking after meeting Qatar’s prime minister, a key mediator, Trump said further strikes were “quite unlikely” but that the US was “locked and loaded”. Meanwhile, Iran’s security chief Mohsen Rezaei told Washington to stop “manufacturing fake news about imaginary talks”.

results.title: Trump vows to back Pete Hegseth as Republican lawmaker pushes impeachment vote
results.content: Republican Congressman Thomas Massie is seeking to impeach US Defence Secretary Pete Hegseth, accusing him of waging military action against Iran for more than 90 days without congressional authorisation.

results.title: Senegal: Footage reveals wreckage of deadly migrant boat in which 39 people died
results.content: At least 39 people have died after a migrant boat sank off Senegal's Atlantic coast. Footage shows the shattered vessel washed ashore as rescuers continue searching for victims.

results.title: Trump says Nvidia CEO Huang knew nothing about alleged Chinese spy
results.content: US President Donald Trump says the FBI is looking into a matter involving Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang and alleged links to a Chinese government agent. Trump said he had spoken to Huang, who denied knowing the person was a spy, and expressed confidence in the tech executive.

results.title: Peru: Giant statue of Pope Leo XIV unveiled ahead of papal visit
results.content: A giant statue of Pope Leo XIV has been unveiled in Callao, Peru, ahead of his upcoming visit. The monument honours the pontiff's close ties to the country, where he previously served as a missionary and bishop.

results.title: MWC26 Doha: Mobile economy in MENA set to reach €421bn, but millions remain offline
results.content: MWC26 returned to Doha as the industry faces a dual challenge: building the networks that will power artificial intelligence and narrowing a digital divide that still leaves millions of people without mobile internet.

results.title: Republican congressman launches impeachment procedure against US defence chief Hegseth
results.content: Republican Kentucky Congressman Thomas Massie introduced eight articles of impeachment against US Defence Secretary Pete Hegseth, including alleged violations of the 1973 War Powers Resolution, as well as misconduct involving civilian casualties and operations in Yemen and Venezuela.

results.title: Turkey: Steel plant explosion kills 17 in Izmir province
results.content: A devastating explosion at the Habaş iron and steelworks in Aliağa, in western Turkey has killed 17 people. Witnesses described an earthquake-like blast, while footage shows flames, thick smoke and distressed relatives outside the factory.

results.title: Poland: Tusk and Nawrocki honour six victims of Kraków shooting
results.content: Poland's President and Prime Minister set aside their political differences to honour the six victims of a deadly shooting in Kraków. The two leaders laid candles and knelt together at a vigil in the historic city centre.

results.title: Turkey: Delegates arrive in Antalya as COP31 climate talks begin
results.content: The United Nations COP31 climate summit has opened in Antalya after a year marked by deadly heatwaves and devastating floods. Delegates face fresh challenges as the war in Iran disrupts global energy supplies.

results.title: Argentina: Pope Leo XIV urges Milei's government to protect the most vulnerable
results.content: The Pontiff visited the Cottolengo Don Orione, which cares for over 400 people and has been hit by Javier Milei's cuts, and said a nation's progress should be judged by how it treats those most in need.

results.title: Argentina: Pope Leo XIV receives warm welcome in Claypole
results.content: Pope Leo XIV was welcomed by crowds in Claypole, near Buenos Aires, as he visited the Don Orione care home. The pontiff greeted the faithful and unveiled a plaque during his 12-day South American tour.

results.title: Norway dropped from junior hockey championship to make room for Russia
results.content: The IIHF has moved Norway, ranked 10th, to Division 1A to free a place for Russia at the tournament in Alberta, after the Court of Arbitration for Sport ordered Russian teams reinstated. The change is not yet confirmed, and Russia has not been guaranteed Canadian visas.

results.title: Ukraine hits Russia’s second-largest refinery as fuel rationing spreads
results.content: Three main processing units at the KINEF plant which handles about 7% of Russia’s refining capacity and supplies St Petersburg’s Pulkovo airport were damaged. Rosneft separately capped fuel sales in six regions, limiting drivers to 30 litres per transaction in cities.
